payload.reason: The evidence provides a comparison of the model's performance against baseline methods in the context of recipe retrieval, highlighting improvements in training time and retrieval results.

claims.text: The model outperforms baseline methods in training efficiency, reducing training time from six days to under 30 hours.
The model utilizes self-attention to directly process raw recipe text, improving retrieval results compared to baseline methods that require preprocessing.
The ingredient attention mechanism enhances the model's ability to focus on relevant parts of instructions, contributing to better retrieval performance than baseline methods.
